[SWS_CM_10498] Remote access control on executing methods
Upstream requirements:
RS_AP_00158
⌈
If a remote subject requests the execution of a method of a service interface, but there
exists no
ComMethodGrant
that
• references the requesting remote subject in the role
remoteSubject
and
• references a
ProvidedApServiceInstance
in the role
serviceInstance
and
• references the requested method in the role
serviceDeployment
,
then Communication Management shall drop the request.
⌋
Note:
In [SWS_CM_10498], field getters and setters are also methods.
